A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as a '''false Prophet of the Dark Side'''. He was a member of the [[Church of the Dark Side]], a mock religion established by the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He wore a full beard and used [[spectacles]]. When the pseudo-Kadann welcomed [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] aboard [[Scardia Station]], the members of the Church honored him with a banquet held in their most formal dining hall. Like most members Prophets, the bespectacled Prophet had a refined personality, and had a hard time tolerating the Hutt's poor table manners. When Zorba started to thrown food all over the place while he was eating, the Prophet was hit by a jet of skewers, which prompted him to protect his face.

All the false Prophets of the Dark Side, but one named [[Orloc]], were killed when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Afsheen Makati|Makati]] [[Bombardment of Scardia Station|bombarded]] [[Scardia Station]].<ref name="ENDTSD" />
